listing.name: Tweaked Transverse Jump
listing.summary: Description: Transverse Jump will no longer disable other abilities when activated; Sustained Burn most notably. A message will also be shown telling you what planet a gravity well belongs to when you stop in it and you will be prompted to turn on your transponder if jumping into non-hostile space.
listing.aiSummary: Prevents Transverse Jump from disabling other abilities like Sustained Burn and adds informational messages for gravity wells and transponder prompts.

aiDescription: Modifies the Transverse Jump ability so it no longer disables other active abilities, such as Sustained Burn. Displays a message indicating which planet a gravity well belongs to when stopping in it. Prompts the player to turn on their transponder when jumping into non-hostile space.
